description: IAM User Can Potentially Assume Administrator-Like Role
rationale: User identity policies plus inherited group policies appear to allow sts:AssumeRole into an admin-like IAM role with an exact AWS principal or same-account root trust. Effective permission and cross-account constraints are not simulated.
remediation: Limit sts:AssumeRole scope, tighten target role trust and verify SCPs, boundaries, MFA/session constraints.
